summary: Compound duration output for deploy logs, now required to be time.ParseDuration-compatible. The whitespace-tolerant parse() fix is committed. The compound docs and tests are written but uncommitted.
narrative: The owner changed the plan for the compound format. The deploy logs are scraped by a Go service using time.ParseDuration, so output must be glued together with hours as the largest unit (e.g. 25h30m), not spaced like '1d 1h 30m'. They deferred that change and first asked for parse() to tolerate surrounding whitespace, since YAML configs produce values like ' 2d'. The agent added str.trim() before the regex, added regression tests (suite 177/177, lint and tsc clean) and committed it as e3b0ddd, separate from the compound feature. A second conversation then asked to wrap up the compound option with README docs and tests. JSDoc, a README section and boundary tests were added (182 passing), but they remained uncommitted. The agent also noted that the compound output does not round-trip through parse(). Memory shows no change to the ParseDuration-compatible format and no PR or release, so the work is unfinished.

milestones.text: Owner changes plan: compound output must be Go ParseDuration-compatible (e.g. 25h30m).
parse() now trims surrounding whitespace, fixing NaN on ' 2d' and '1.5h '.
Whitespace fix committed as e3b0ddd after tests and lint passed.
Compound README section and boundary tests added; suite at 182 passing, not yet committed.
